title: Dolomites
description: Analogue photographs from the Dolomites by Bart Mulder: wooden cabins, mountain meadows and snow-capped peaks, all shot on film.

images.alt: A rustic wooden cabin with a slanted roof and a small shed attached, set in a green meadow with a red pickup truck parked nearby. The background features forested hills and snow-capped mountains under a partly cloudy sky.
A wooden cabin on a grassy hillside with green rolling hills and ski lift towers in the background under a partly cloudy sky.
Scenic mountain landscape with three wooden cabins on grassy slopes, a dirt path leading through the scene, and a small pond reflecting the surrounding hills and cabins.
Mountain range with snow-capped peaks and green grassy slopes, partly clouded sky.
Mountain landscape with green trees, grass, and grazing animals, with snow-capped mountains partially covered by clouds in the background.
An outdoor scene with a ping pong table on a paved patio, surrounded by old stone and stucco buildings, set against a backdrop of green, forested mountains.
Scenic mountain landscape with a wooden cabin in the foreground, green grassy field, lush forest, and snow-capped mountains under a partly cloudy sky.
